Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game. Philip Salt has powered England to victory here. The series is now level at 3-3 and there will be all to play for in the final game. The 7th and final T20I will be played on the 2nd of October, Sunday. The match will start at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Do join us for the early build-up. Till then, goodbye and cheers!!!

Moeen Ali, the captain of England is up for a chat. He says that is very happy and the way they batted was outstanding. Mentions that if they stick to the process and play the correct shots they will most likely do well. Adds that the fast bowlers did really well. Admits that the series has been brilliant and they are looking forward to an exciting decider. About Jos Butler, claims that he is feeling good and getting some practice but they may not risk him before the World Cup.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan is up for a chat. He says that he felt that they had a good score as they were aiming for 170 but could have got a few more runs. Credits Philip Salt for getting England off to a good start in the Powerplay and claims that the momentum was on their side after that. Admits that the middle order needs to step up and perform if they are to do well. Adds that he is hopeful they can do so in future games.

Philip Salt is the MAN OF THE MATCH for his excellent innings of 88 off 41 balls. He says that it was one of his best T20 innings and a good time to get it with the series on the balance. Claims that it is tough at the top of the order and even when they are playing good shots they find the fielders or sometimes get out but is glad about the backing he has received from the team. Admits that in all the best sides in the world there will always be competition and it is good to take the opportunity and make the most of it.
Time for the presentation...

Earlier, in the day Babar Azam played a beautiful inning of 87 runs and took his side to a decent score of 169. Looking at the pitch, it was a defendable total but the way the English batters batted proved everyone wrong. Sam Curran was brilliant with the ball with two wickets, but the other bowlers were a bit expensive. However, their batters put on an amazing show to chase the total down in just 14.3 overs. The series is now tied 3-3 and it will be all to play for in the final T20I.

Pakistan were shell shocked from the very first ball. All of their bowlers got the same treatment except for Shadab and they looked out of ideas. They did not do much wrong but Philip Salt looked to be in prime form and the other batters were on song too. Shadab Khan was their best bowler with two wickets which were the only wickets that fell. They will want to forget this performance and come back with a fresh mindset for the deciding game.

The English batters stepped up big time and how. They absolutely hammered the bowlers all around the park. Alex Hales and Philip Salt took on the bowling right from the start and added 55 runs for the opening stand before Hales got out on 27 off 12 balls. Philip Salt continued his onslaught with Dawid Malan and they ended the Powerplay on 82/1. He got to his fifty in just 19 balls. Salt finished on an unbeaten 88 and fittingly hit the winning runs. Ben Duckett and Malan also contributed with the bat. After two disappointing losses while chasing, they have capped an incredible display with a resounding win.

We have seen a chasing masterclass from England and especially from Philip Salt here! They have been absolutely amazing with the bat and have chased down 170 runs with 33 balls to spare. England have levelled the series in style with an 8-wicket win.

Philip Salt scores the winning run and he deserves all the applause there! Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and outside the off pole, Philip Salt strokes this to deep cover and takes a run to clinch a dominating win and level the series 3-3.
Another short delivery aimed for the batter, Ben Duckett pulls this to deep square leg and takes one. Scores are level now.
Bangs this in short and outside off, takes pace off the ball. Philip Salt checks his shot and knocks the ball to long off for a single.
WIDE! Strays down leg on a fuller length, Philip Salt misses his clip and this is called wide by the umpire.

FOUR! England end the over with a boundary once again! Aamer Jamal goes for the short ball once again and serves this outside off, Ben Duckett is in position quickly and pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for yet another four runs. England are now just one hit away from leveling the series.
Aamer Jamal bangs this in short and outside off, Philip Salt misses his pulla and gets hit on the shoulder. They take another leg bye.
This is bowled on a shorter length and outside off, Ben Duckett pulls this towards deep square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and angled into the stumps, Philip Salt goes for the pull shot but gets an inside edge high on the pads. A single is taken.
FOUR! Philip Salt continues his onslaught! Aamer Jamal bowls this short as well and outside off, Philip Salt stands tall and wacks this back past the bowler for a straight boundary.
Aamer Jamal bowls this back of a length and outside off, Philip Salt cuts this straight to backward point.
Aamer Jamal is back on. He conceded 20 runs in his first over.

FOUR! Ben Duckett times this beautifully! Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and in line with the stumps, Ben Duckett clips this towards the deep mid-wicket boundary for four runs. 15 runs are needed now in 42 balls.
This is a fraction short as well and outside off, Philip Salt slaps this down to long on for a single.

Mohammad Nawaz bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Philip Salt looks to cut but misses. The keeper whips the bail and they go upstairs to check for a stumping. UltraEdge shows no bat involved and the side on camera shows that Philip Salt is comfortably in.
This is floated full and outside off, Ben Duckett pushes the ball towards long on and takes one.
This is full and outside off, Ben Duckett shimmies down the wicket and looks to heave it leg side but gets an inside edge onto himself.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and follows the batter to the leg side. Philip Salt makes room and thumps this towards long off for a single.
Quicker once again, full and on the pads, Ben Duckett paddles it towards fine leg for a brace.
Darts this down the leg side, Ben Duckett misses his flick and it goes off his pads to the leg side.
FOUR! This time the traditional sweep! Shadab Khan floats this up, full and on middle, Ben Duckett sweeps it hard towards the deep square leg fence for another boudnary.
FOUR! Good shot! This is short and on middle, Ben Duckett goes for the revers sweep and hits it nicely towards the deep point fence for a boudnary.
Quciker, full and on middle, Philip Salt forces it towards long on for a single.

TURN AND BOUNCE! This is tossed up, full and on off, turming away sharply, Philip Salt goes for the slog but gets a outisde edge and the ball goes off the shoulders of the keeper, Mohammad Haris towards the third man region. Two more runs taken.
Floated, full and on off, Ben Duckett drives it firmly wide of mid off where the fielder dives to his right to make half stop. Two runs taken.

This is tossed up, full and around off, Ben Duckett goes for the reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. Mohammad Nawaz convinces his skipper, Babar Azam to go for the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat invloved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching outside off and the onfield decison of NOT OUT remains. Ben Duckett survives.
Fires in a yorker, on middle, Philip Salt digs it towards long on for a run.
Another single as this full delivery is drives towards long off by Duckett.
Short and on off, Philip Salt makes room and forces it towards long off for a single.
Slower through the air, on leg, Ben Duckett flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.

DRINKS! This has been a pounding from the English batters especially Philip Salt, who seems to be in a hurry to get done with this game. He has put his team in a comfortable position to level the series and will be hoping to stay there till the end. Pakistan have managed to take a couple of wickets but have gifted far too many freebies to their opponents. They will need a massive performance after the break if they are to claw back into the game.
A bit short and on off, Philip Salt slaps it back to the bowler. Shadab Khan is having a little bit of fun by faking a throw at the batter;s end.
Darts this down the leg side, Ben Duckett tucks it through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Looped up, full and on middle, Ben Duckett drives it back to the bowler.
This should be a walk in the park now for England. They have done way too much damage upfront and 42 runs are now needed in 63 balls. Pakistan will be hoping for a collapse here.
Ben Duckett is the new batter out in the middle.

OUT! LBW! Shadab Khan gets the breakthrough yet again and this time it Malan who has to go back. He bowls this flatter, short and on middle, keeps very low, Dawid Malan looks to flick it but the ball goes under his bat and hits him on the pads right in front of the stumps. There is a huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. However, Dawid Malan decides to go for the review. Ball Tracking shows three reds and it is plumb. England lose their second.
A bit short and on off, Dawid Malan moves back and knocks it back to the bowler.
Flatter, full and on the pads, Dawid Malan misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg.
Shahnawaz Dahani bowls another slower delivery full and just outside the off pole, Philip Salt looks to play at this but gets beaten by the pace and the ball goes really close to the stumps.

FOUR! Two boundaries in a row once again! Shahnawaz Dahani bangs this one short and in line with the stumps, Philip Salt looks to pull and gets a top edge that flies over the keeper's head and runs away to the straightish fine leg boundary for four more runs.

FOUR! Philip Salt keeps motoring along! Shahnawaz Dahani serves a slower ball and attempts a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss outside off. Philip Salt crunches this through the infield and finds the deep cover boundary for four runs.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Dawid Malan slaps this to deep point and takes one.
Goes full this time and angles the ball into the stumps, Philip Salt clips this towards deep mid-wicket and they settle for a run.
Shahnawaz Dahani begins with a full delivery outside off, Dawid Malan works this to deep point and takes one.
Shahnawaz Dahani comes back into the attack. He conceded 22 runs in his first over.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and this time it ahs come from the bat of Philip Salt! Shadab Khan bowls this short and outside off, Philip Salt leans back and pulls this towards long on and the ball lands just short of the ropes. 15 runs have come from this over.
This is in line with the stumps on a shorter length, Dawid Malan goes back in the crease and works this to long on for a single.

FOUR! A low full toss for a gift this time! Shadab Khan serves this outside off, Dawid Malan is onto it in a flash and finds the gap in the off side once again and the ball races away to the deep cover fence for four more runs.
FOUR! Shadab Khan now serves lolly outside off! Flights this one full and gives room for Dawid Malan to free his arms and drill the ball to deep cover for a boundary.
This is floated in full and into the stumps, Philip Salt shimmies down the wicket and clips this to deep mid-wicket and takes another run.
Shadab Khan flights this full and pitches this on leg, Dawid Malan clips this towards square leg and takes a single.
Shadab Khan is back on. 5 runs from his first over and a wicket.

SIX! This just about clears the fence and England reach 100 in 7 overs! This is short as well and outside off, Philip Salt does even better as he bulls this flat and gets the ball over the ropes at deep square leg for six more runs. 20 runs have come from this over.

FOUR! The batters are taking turns here to get collect runs for themselves! Aamer Jamal bowls this short and outside off, sits up nicely for Philip Salt who slaps this towards deep square leg for four runs.
A slower delivery bowled full and on the pads, Dawid Malan clips this to deep square leg and takes a single.

FOUR! Pakistan are feeding the English batters with some freebies here! This is served full and outside the off pole, Dawid Malan gets his front foot forward and drives this to the deep cover boundary for an elegant shot!
That brings up the fifty for Philip Salt and he has got there in just 19 deliveries! Aamer Jamal bowls this short and just outside off, Philip Salt pulls this to deep square leg and takes a single.

FOUR! Philip Salt does not care that the Powerplay is over! Aamer Jamal begins with a full delivery outside the off pole, Philip Salt reaches for the ball and thumps this towards the deep cover boundary for four runs.
Aamer Jamal comes into the attack now.

Continues bowling outside off on a good length, Dawid Malan leans into the shot but gets beaten on his outside edge. This has been an outstanding Powerplay for England as they have scored 82 runs for the loss of 1 wicket.
This is on a good length and outside off, Dawid Malan blocks this towards point.
This is full as well and in line with the stumps, Dawid Malan flicks this straight to the mid-wicket fielder this time.

FOUR! This is definitely convincing! Great timing from Dawid Malan as he gets back-to-back boundaries. Mohammad Wasim bowls full and on the pads, the batter clips this to the left of mid-wicket and collects four more runs.

FOUR! This is probably the most unconvincing boundary we have seen so far! Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Dawid Malan pushes at this and gets an outside edge that flies to the third man boundary for four runs.
Mohammad Wasim begins the over with a full delivery outside off, Dawid Malan taps this towards point.
Mohammad Wasim is back on.

FOUR! Salt is absolutely putting everything away! Mohammad Nawaz again tosses it up, full and on middle, Philip Salt chips it over the bowler's head for a boundary this time. This is the highest Powerplay score for England in this series and still 1 over to go.
SIX! BANG! This is outstanding batting from Salt! This is floated, full again and on middle, Philip Salt clears his front leg and powers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
FOUR! Great shot and he is playing with the field perfectly. This is tossed up, full and on middle, Philip Salt makes room and smashes it over extra cover for another boundary.
Quicker, full and on middle, Philip Salt drills it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Salt continues to find the fence! Nawaz flights this up, full and on middle, Philip Salt lofts it wide of the long on fence for a boudnary.
Mohammad Nawaz bowls this full and fires this into the stumps, Dawid Malan tucks this towards square leg and takes a single to get off the mark.
This is fired in on a yorker length and in line with the stumps, Philip Salt digs this out back towards the bowler.
Dawid Malan makes his way out at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Shadab Khan strikes and this exactly why he was brought into the attack. He gets the dangerous, Hales. He tosses it up, full and on off, Alex Hales goes for the sweep but gets a top edge towards short fine leg where Shahnawaz Dahani runs to his right to take a nice catch. A much needed wicket for Pakistan and England lose their first.
Commentary.Howout: c Shahnawaz Dahani b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Good running! This is tossed up, full and on off, Alex Hales makes room and drills it wide of mid off where the fielder dives to his left to stop. Two more runs added to the board.
Floated, full and on off, Alex Hales knocks it towards covers.
Short again and on middle, Alex Hales slaps it wide of deep mid-wicket where the fielder covers his ground and stops it with his foot. Two runs taken!
Tossed up, short and on off, Philip Salt moves back and forces it towards long off for a single.
Shadab Khan comes into the attack.

FOUR! Make that three in a row! This has been powered away! Mohammad Wasim bowls this full and around off, Alex Hales absloutely crunches it past the mid off fielder for his third boundary in tge over. 17 runs from the over. That also brings up the 50 for England!
FOUR! Another one! This is short again and on leg, Alex Hales gets cramped a bit but still manages to pull it over the short fine leg fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! The boundaries are flowing here! Mohammad Wasim bowls this short of a length and on middle, Alex Hales stays there and pulls it towards the vacant deep mid-wicket fence for four more runs.
Short of a length and on middle and leg, Alex Hales looks to cut very close from his body but misses.
Full and on off, Philip Salt drills it straight at mid off where the fielder fumbles a bit. A single is taken.
FOUR! Philip Salt with a thumping shot to welcome Mohammad Wasim. This is full and on off, Philip Salt moves to the leg side a bit and smashes it over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Mohammad Wasim replaces Mohammad Nawaz.
This is on a good length and outside off, Alex Hales goes for the drive but gets beaten 22 runs from the over and England are off to a flier.
SIX! This has been thumped! This is Alex Hales at his blistering best! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this on a fuller length and outside off, Alex Hales crunches this over deep cover for a maximum!
WIDE! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this short and way outside the off pole, Alex Hales swings his arms at it but is nowhere close. The umpire calls this wide.
Four! Alex Hales has played a sublime shot! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Alex Hales gets on his toes and caresses this towards deep point for a boundary.
Continues bowling short and outside off, Philip Salt pulls this towards mid off and a half stop allows them to take a single.

SIX! Shahnawaz Dahani compensates by going short and in line with the stumps, Philip Salt rocks back and pulls this over the deep backward square leg boundary for a biggie. Shahnawaz Dahani has not started this over well at all.
A very good start for England and Shahnawaz Dahani has been welcomed with a boundary as he shares the attack with Mohammad Nawaz.
FOUR! What a beautiful shot! Shahnawaz Dahani bowls this full and just outside off, Philip Salt leans into the shot and punches the ball past the mid off fielder for four runs.
This is flighted as well as bowled a fraction short. Philip Salt looks to get down the pitch but decides to stay back at the last moment and punch the ball to long off to take a run and keep strike.
Another loopy delivery bowled full and outside off, Alex Hales works this to long off for one more.
This is flighted full and outside off, Philip Salt strokes this to long off for a single.
FOUR! This has been whipped away! Mohammad Nawaz flights this full and outside off, Philip Salt gets forwards and clips this wide of long on for four more runs.
This is full and outside off, Philip Salt knocks this towards mid off.

FOUR! Mohammad Nawaz bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Philip Salt goes back in the crease and cuts this late towards backward point. The ball goes in the air but in the gap and Philip Salt gets off the mark with a boundary.
